ar.title: القنبيط

steps.n2: يوضع في الماء المغلي المضاف إليه الملح والكمون بحيث تكون الزهرة لأسفل والأعناق لأعلى حتى تنضج نوعا ما.
steps.n3: ترفع في مصفاة حتى تجف ثم تحمر في الزيت وترفع على مناديل ورقية.
steps.n4: يضرب البصل والطماطم والفلفل الأخضر والثوم مع الملح والفلفل في الخلاط.
steps.n5: تشوَح هذه الخلطة في إناء به زيت حتى الغليان، ثم نضيف المرق.
steps.n6: بعد الغليان نحضر البايركس ثم نخلط القنبيط بالعصاج، ونسكب عليه المرق الممزوج بالصلصة، ويوضع في فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى النضج.

en.title: Qanbeet (Fried Cauliflower)

steps.n1: Cut the cauliflower and remove the thick stems.
steps.n2: Place it in boiling water seasoned with salt and cumin, ensuring the florets are facing down and the stems are facing up, until partially cooked.
steps.n3: Remove using a strainer to drain, then fry in oil until golden and place on paper towels to drain.
steps.n4: Blend the onion, tomatoes, green pepper, and garlic with salt and pepper in a blender.
steps.n5: Sauté this mixture in a pot with oil until it boils, then add the broth.
steps.n6: Once boiling, prepare a Pyrex dish, mix the cauliflower with the minced meat, pour the sauce-mixed broth over it, and bake in a medium oven until cooked through.

legacySteps: Cut the cauliflower and remove the thick stems.
Place it in boiling water seasoned with salt and cumin, ensuring the florets are facing down and the stems are facing up, until partially cooked.
Remove using a strainer to drain, then fry in oil until golden and place on paper towels to drain.
Blend the onion, tomatoes, green pepper, and garlic with salt and pepper in a blender.
Sauté this mixture in a pot with oil until it boils, then add the broth.
Once boiling, prepare a Pyrex dish, mix the cauliflower with the minced meat, pour the sauce-mixed broth over it, and bake in a medium oven until cooked through.
